name: Murray Darling
terms: Australia's Geographical Indications nest in three levels: zones, the regions inside them, and subregions inside those.

notes: Chardonnay, its most important premium wine, has a fruity softness and generosity.
Shiraz and Cabernet have plenty of soft, sweet fruit and are best drunk at one to two years old.

blurb.text: A large wine region straddling the Murray River, partly in the Big Rivers zone of New South Wales and partly in the North West Victoria zone.
